def admit(args):
    global _EXPECTED_ROOT_THREAD,_OWNER_SUPPORT_MANIFEST,_OWNER_SUPPORT,_CURRENT_OWNER_SCOPE
    global _STAGE_FACTS,_STAGE_FACTS_PIN,_STAGE_REVIEW_PIN,_STAGE_ADOPTION_PIN,_STAGE_FULL_PROOF_PIN
    global _STAGE_REVIEW,_STAGE_ADOPTION,_STAGE_PURPOSE,_STAGE_ROWS
    need(os.name == 'nt' and Path(__file__).absolute() == SELF and args.physical_actor == '/root'
        and Path(sys.executable) == GENERAL_HOST and sys.flags.isolated == 1 and sys.flags.no_site == 1
        and sys.dont_write_bytecode, 'exact reviewed I2 Source under explicit isolated native Python313; actual Root serializer only')
    need(type(args.expected_root_thread) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}',args.expected_root_thread),
        'actual externally authenticated Root thread explicitly bound, never defaulted from a historical chat')
    _EXPECTED_ROOT_THREAD = args.expected_root_thread
    self_raw = read(SELF,args.expected_self_sha256);self_pin = fact(SELF,self_raw)
    api_raw = read(API_PATH,args.expected_API_sha256);api_pin = fact(API_PATH,api_raw);api = strict_source_json(api_raw)
    need(api['Source'] == self_pin and api['author'] == EDITOR and api['actual_binding_Source_editor'] == BINDING_SOURCE_EDITOR
        and type(api['schema_version']) is int and api['schema_version'] == 2
        and api['record_type'] == 'Root_owner_v2_M3_deferred_metadata_inert_API'
        and api['target_execution'] is False and api['operational_authority'] is False,
        'actual immutable owner-v2 Source/API with truthful current implementation editor')
    facts_raw = read(args.facts,args.expected_facts_sha256);facts_pin = fact(args.facts,facts_raw);facts = strict_source_json(facts_raw)
    need(type(facts) is dict and set(facts) == FACT_KEYS and len(facts) == 21
        and type(facts['schema_version']) is int and facts['schema_version'] == 2
        and facts['record_type'] == M3_PURPOSE_TYPE and facts['author'] == '/root'
        and facts['Root_thread'] == _EXPECTED_ROOT_THREAD and facts['stage'] == args.stage
        and facts['source_only'] is True and facts['canonical_publication'] is False and facts['native_Parser_authority'] is False,
        'actual separately reviewed closed21 exact Root M3 Source stage-purpose/facts; reject old/missing/unknown versions')
    no_authority(facts)
    _CURRENT_OWNER_SCOPE = exact_fact3(facts['current_owner_scope'])
    _STAGE_FACTS,_STAGE_FACTS_PIN = facts,facts_pin
    manifest_raw = read(args.owner_support_manifest,args.expected_owner_support_manifest_sha256)
    _OWNER_SUPPORT_MANIFEST = fact(args.owner_support_manifest,manifest_raw)
    _OWNER_SUPPORT = strict_source_json(manifest_raw)
    need(type(_OWNER_SUPPORT) is dict and set(_OWNER_SUPPORT) == OWNER_SUPPORT_KEYS
        and _OWNER_SUPPORT['current_owner_scope'] == _CURRENT_OWNER_SCOPE,
        'exact required CLI-pinned owner support3 manifest crossjoined to facts21')
    for pin in _OWNER_SUPPORT.values():read_pin(exact_fact3(pin))
    scope = strict_source_json(read_pin(_CURRENT_OWNER_SCOPE))
    need(scope.get('Root_thread') == _EXPECTED_ROOT_THREAD, 'actual owner-context Root thread crossjoin before later pure I0 authentication')
    read_pin(exact_fact3(scope['owner_instruction_record']));read_pin(exact_fact3(scope['owner_policy_record']))
    scope_review = strict_source_json(read_pin(_OWNER_SUPPORT['different_current_owner_scope_Source_review']))
    read_pin(exact_fact3(scope_review['full_proof']))
    _validate_fixed_context()
    need(type(facts['tool_support']) is dict and set(facts['tool_support']) == {'Source','API','different_review','Root_adoption'}
        and facts['tool_support']['Source'] == self_pin and facts['tool_support']['API'] == api_pin,
        'original exact4 actual tool/API/different Source review/Root adoption; no guessed acceptance')
    reviewed_support3({key:facts['tool_support'][key] for key in ('different_review','Root_adoption')},
